prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous warm-ivory complexion, early 20s goddess, amazoness physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad; a commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist; enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves; powerful, statuesque and imposing; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, blunt bob auburn hair — her body is painted in 5 different painting styles at once, each style claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 5 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 41% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 4 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 38%, 56%, 79% and 91% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries Matisse style paper cut-out shapes, bold seaweed-like leaf forms in flat cobalt blue, coral and yellow. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries Picasso style cubist planes, fragmented geometric shapes and angular faces in ochre, blue and terracotta. Region 3 is the ring between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries Munch The Scream style flowing wavy bands of blood-orange, blue and black swirling over her curves. Region 4 is the ring between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries Jackson Pollock style action painting, tangled drips and splatters of black, white, orange and teal flung across her skin. Region 5 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it carries Mondrian style grid of thick black lines with flat blocks of primary red, yellow and blue and white. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, perfectly circular course, every painting laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: standing facing the camera straight on, her left hand resting on her hip and her right arm relaxed at her side, her legs fully in view — most extreme amazoness silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy hot pink leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each as long as her whole hand, in hot pink lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large chandelier earrings of tin and blackened iron as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Chinese woman (East Asian Chinese features: a longer oval face with prominent high cheekbones and a defined jawline, long upturned phoenix-shaped eyes with sharp inner folds, a high strong nose bridge, thin arched eyebrows with a slight rise, balanced lips), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: clearly visible, bold and well defined: bold white eyeshadow across the lids, white glossy lips, a bright turquoise liner accent at the outer corners, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows light natural skin glow, subtle healthy sheen.

Background: a sunny city plaza of light paving with a low fountain edge, a street lamp and standard-height shop doors behind her, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
